title: The Short letter from the office
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：short　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 short 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the keeper wrote of ① a short letter from the office in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② shorter than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the short ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the shortest letter from the office anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too short to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the short ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a short supply of coal, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as short as the supply of coal they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was short or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something short, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite short; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the short ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, at once, she wrote of another short letter from the office in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ shorter than anybody had expected. ⑩ The shortest supply of coal in the whole tower, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the short ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 简短（前置定语 a short letter from the office：1964 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件简短的来函）
B. adj. 简短／短缺（比较级 shorter than：文中两处，一处比办公室简短的来函，一处比预想）
C. adj. 简短／短缺（最高级 the shortest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 简短（表语 too short to do：母亲觉得它太简短，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 短缺（前置定语 a short supply of coal：叔叔把整件事称作一桩短缺的煤的短缺）
F. adj. 短缺（同级比较 as short as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩煤的短缺相比）
G. adj. 短缺（后置定语 something short：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 短缺（受程度副词修饰 quite short：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a short letter from the office
the shortest letter from the office anybody
The shortest supply of coal in

answers.why: short 意为“简短”，1964 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件简短的来函”，此处作前置定语 a short letter from the office。
short 意为“简短”，此处用比较级 shorter than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
short 意为“简短”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最简短的一件，故用最高级 the shortest letter from the office。
short 意为“简短”，母亲认为这件东西“太简短了，谁也用不上”，too short to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
short 意为“短缺”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩短缺的煤的短缺”，此处作前置定语 a short supply of coal。
short 意为“短缺”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩煤的短缺一样短缺”，同级比较用 as short as。
short 意为“短缺”，年历上那半行字要的是“短缺的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something short。
short 意为“短缺”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当短缺”，quite 修饰原级 short。
short 意为“短缺”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要短缺”，故用比较级 shorter than。
short 意为“短缺”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个钟楼里最短缺的那一桩”，故用最高级 the shortest supply of coal。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件简短的来函。（a short letter from the office）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更简短。（shorter than …）
母亲觉得它太简短，谁也用不上。（too short to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩短缺的煤的短缺。（a short supply of coal）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩煤的短缺一样短缺。（as short as …）
到了 1971 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件短缺的东西。（something short）
answers: In 1964 the keeper wrote of a short letter from the office in the calendar.
Everybody said it was shorter than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too short to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a short supply of coal.
He said nobody would call it as short as the supply of coal they had once had.
By 1971 the calendar asked for nothing but something short.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 short 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the keeper wrote of a short letter from the office in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the shortest letter from the office in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too short to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a short supply of coal, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite short, and everybody laughed.
The short ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
